paper_title: Search for axion-like particles through nuclear Primakoff production using the GlueX detector
coupling_convention: 1/Lambda in GeV^-1, defined via L = (1/4Lambda) a F Fdual (equivalent to g_agamma in GeV^-1)
notes: First GlueX search for ALP-photon coupling via nuclear Primakoff production on 12C (with 4He background subtraction), mass range 200-450 MeV, 95% CL upper limits on 1/Lambda at the O(1e-3 to 1e-2 GeV^-1) scale (O(1 TeV)). No numerical table is given; data points are approximate values read from the description of Fig. 7 (text states limits at O(1 TeV) scale with most stringent limit ~1e-3 GeV^-1 at ma~360 MeV due to a downward fluctuation). The observed limits fluctuate strongly with mass, so intermediate values are indicative only. Paper also contains future projections (Pb target, 1 fb^-1) which are NOT included here.
